item.title: Lady Jackets downed by Hardin-Simmons, 73-46, in ASC women’s basketball championship game
item.description: ABILENE – Bidding for their first American Southwest Conference women’s basketball championship since 2011, the Howard Payne Lady Jackets hung with Hardin-Simmons for a quarter, but the Cowgirls eventually ran away with a 73-46 victory Saturday afternoon.
